name: SigmaOS
title: sigmaos.com
payoff: The new home for your internet
shortDescription: SigmaOS is a revolutionary browser designed to enhance productivity and organization online. It introduces features like workspaces, vertical tabs, and split-screen to help users manage their internet use more efficiently. Ideal for professionals and students who juggle multiple tasks and websites, SigmaOS allows users to treat tabs as tasks, organize them into workspaces, and search content quickly. An example use case is a project manager organizing tabs related to different projects into separate workspaces for easy access.
pros: Enhanced tab management with workspaces and vertical tabs
Integrated search and task features for increased productivity
Ad-free browsing and focus mode for minimal distractions
cons: Limited to Apple devices due to WebKit and SwiftUI
May have a learning curve due to unique features
Potential compatibility issues with some web extensions
